methods.doc: Starts cloning media from sourceDir to targetDirs. Use SetCloneToolSettings to configure PreserveFolderName/ChecksumType beforehand.

methods.name: SetCloneToolSettings
methods.doc: Sets the PreserveFolderName/ChecksumType options used by subsequent StartCloneMedia calls (and by the Clone Tool UI).

methods.name: StopCloneMedia
methods.doc: Stops the currently in-progress clone job started via StartCloneMedia. Returns False if no clone job is in progress.

methods.name: GetCloneStatus
methods.doc: Returns a dict with the status of the current (or most recently started) clone job

methods.name: GetName
methods.doc: Returns the photo album name.

methods.name: SetName
methods.doc: Sets the photo album name if photoAlbumName (string) is unique.

methods.name: GetUniqueId
methods.doc: Returns a unique ID for the photo album

methods.name: GetPhotoList
methods.doc: Returns a list of photo album items in the photo album.

methods.name: ExportThumbnails
methods.args: self, photoIndices: list[int], exportThumbnailsOptions: ExportThumbnailsOptions | None = None
methods.doc: Renders the photos at the given 1-based album positions into a single grid image, one cell per photo labelled with its position, 1 <= photoIndex <= GetPhotoList() size

methods.name: GetCurrentItem
methods.doc: Returns the current photo album item.

methods.name: DeletePhotos
methods.doc: Deletes specified PhotoAlbumItems from the photo album.

methods.name: GetNodeGraph
methods.doc: Returns the photo album's node graph object.

methods.name: GetMediaPoolItem
methods.doc: Returns the media pool item corresponding to the photo album

methods.name: GrabStill
methods.doc: Grabs still from the current photo. Returns a GalleryStill object.

methods.name: GrabAllStills
methods.doc: Grabs stills from all photos in the photo album.

methods.name: GetName
methods.doc: Returns the item name

methods.name: SetName
methods.doc: Sets the photo's name to name.

methods.name: GetUniqueId
methods.doc: Returns a unique ID for the photo album item

methods.name: GetFusionCompCount
methods.doc: Returns number of Fusion compositions associated with the photo album item

methods.name: GetFusionCompNameList
methods.doc: Returns a list of Fusion composition names associated with the photo album item

methods.name: GetFusionCompByIndex
methods.doc: Returns the Fusion composition object based on given index. 1 <= compIndex <= photoAlbumItem.GetFusionCompCount()

methods.name: GetFusionCompByName
methods.doc: Returns the Fusion composition object based on given name

methods.name: AddFusionComp
methods.doc: Adds a new Fusion composition associated with the photo album item

methods.name: DeleteFusionCompByName
methods.doc: Deletes the named Fusion composition

methods.name: LoadFusionCompByName
methods.doc: Loads the named Fusion composition as the active composition

methods.name: RenameFusionCompByName
methods.doc: Renames the Fusion composition identified by oldName

methods.name: ImportFusionComp
methods.doc: Imports a Fusion composition from given file path by creating and adding a new composition for the item

methods.name: ExportFusionComp
methods.doc: Exports the Fusion composition based on given index to the path provided

methods.name: GetMediaPoolItem
methods.doc: Returns the media pool item corresponding to the photo album item if one exists

methods.name: AddFlag
methods.doc: Adds a flag with given color (string)

methods.name: GetFlagList
methods.doc: Returns a list of flag colors assigned to the item

methods.name: ClearFlags
methods.doc: Clears flags of the specified color. An 'All' argument is supported to clear all flags

methods.name: GetClipColor
methods.doc: Returns the item color as a string

methods.name: SetClipColor
methods.doc: Sets the item color based on the colorName (string)

methods.name: ClearClipColor
methods.doc: Clears the item color

methods.name: CopyGrades
methods.doc: Copies the current node stack layer grade to the same layer for each item in tgtPhotoAlbumItems.

methods.name: ApplyAutoColor
methods.doc: Analyses the photo and applies the automatic balance and grade. Replaces the grade of a previous call and clears the legacy auto color values.

methods.name: SetAutoColorEnabled
methods.doc: Enables or disables the grade a previous ApplyAutoColor() applied

methods.name: GetAutoColorEnabled
methods.doc: Returns whether auto color is applied and enabled, none if it has no auto color

methods.name: ClearAutoColor
methods.doc: Discards auto-color grades

methods.name: GetCurrentVersion
methods.doc: Returns the current version of the photo. The returned value will have the keys versionName and versionType (always 1 - remote, as photo albums only support remote versions)

methods.name: RenameVersionByName
methods.doc: Renames the color version identified by oldName. Photo albums only support remote versions

methods.name: DeleteVersionByName
methods.doc: Deletes a color version by name. Photo albums only support remote versions

methods.name: LoadVersionByName
methods.doc: Loads a named color version as the active version. Photo albums only support remote versions

methods.name: AddVersion
methods.doc: Adds a new color version for a photo. Photo albums only support remote versions

methods.name: GetVersionNameList
methods.doc: Returns a list of all color versions. Photo albums only support remote versions

methods.name: SetCDL
methods.doc: Sets CDL values on the node. Keys of map are: 'NodeIndex', 'Slope', 'Offset', 'Power', 'Saturation'

methods.name: GetCDL
methods.doc: Returns the ASC CDL equivalent of the primaries of the node at nodeIndex, as the dict

methods.name: GetNodeGraph
methods.doc: Returns the photo's node graph object at layerIdx (int, optional). Returns the first layer if layerIdx is skipped. 1 <= layerIdx <= project.GetSetting('nodeStackLayers')

methods.name: ResetAllNodeColors
methods.doc: Resets node color for all nodes in the active version of the photo.

methods.name: ExportLUT
methods.doc: Exports a LUT of the size given by 'exportType', saving it in the provided 'path'

methods.name: GetColorGroup
methods.doc: Returns the photo's color group if one exists

methods.name: AssignToColorGroup
methods.doc: Assigns the photo to the given ColorGroup. ColorGroup must be an existing group in the current project

methods.name: RemoveFromColorGroup
methods.doc: Removes the photo from its ColorGroup

methods.name: LoadBurnInPreset
methods.doc: Loads user defined data burn in preset for photo when supplied presetName (string).

methods.name: GetRatings
methods.doc: Returns the photo rating in stars (0-5)

methods.name: SetRatings
methods.doc: Sets the photo rating to stars (int, 0-5)

methods.name: AddEffect
methods.doc: Applies the effect with the provided category and id (see Resolve.GetEffectsList) to this photo album item

methods.name: GetEffects
methods.doc: Returns the effects of the given category ('fusion' or 'ofx') applied to this photo album item

methods.name: DeleteEffects
methods.doc: Removes the given effects from this photo album item

methods.name: ExportFrame
methods.doc: Exports the photo as a still image per exportFrameOptions.

methods.name: GetProperties
methods.doc: Returns a dict with all supported photo properties (source transform, cropping and looks). See README.md section 'Looking up Photo Album Item properties'.

methods.name: SetProperties
methods.doc: Sets the photo properties (source transform, cropping and looks) with the specified dict of property keys and values. See README.md section 'Looking up Photo Album Item properties'.
